convert_csm_weights_to_hf: convert Csm model weights from original format to HuggingFace Transformers format
build_csm_model_checkpoint: build a Csm model checkpoint by loading original weights and saving as HuggingFace format
create_csm_tokenizer: create a Csm tokenizer based on Llama-3.2-1B with custom audio special tokens
build_csm_processor: build a Csm processor combining tokenizer and feature extractor with chat template
run_csm_conversion_cli: run the Csm weight conversion CLI with input path, model name, codec path, and output directory
